verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official `vastai` CLI. The docs say it covers the entire platform: auth, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints and scoped API keys. They show concrete commands and a full rent-to-cleanup workflow, the CLI lives in the official vast-ai/vast-cli GitHub repo, and an agent skill lets AI coding assistants drive it. The reviewer concern holds: the probe only confirms the docs page exists, and no community or hands-on item shows the CLI in use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented.
